fact: 1932—1933年乌克兰发生人为大饥荒（Holodomor）：莫斯科共产主义政权组织征粮制，在乌克兰与北高加索乌克兰聚居区造成人为饥荒，目的是大规模消灭乌克兰人、摧毁民族意识。

sources.title: Holodomor: main facts（Національний музей Голодомору-геноциду 乌克兰国家大饥荒博物馆）
sources.quote: The Holodomor is a genocide of the Ukrainian people, one of the components of which was the man-made famine of 1932–1933 in Ukraine and those areas of the North Caucasus where the Ukrainian population lived mainly. It was organised by the Moscow communist regime.

sources.title: Putin's Inheritance From Stalin: Fear Of Ukraine（KyivPost）
sources.quote: Stalin's drive to crush Ukrainian nationalism by starving to death 3.9 million Ukrainians in the 1932-1933 Holodomor.

fact: 1933年春季饥荒死亡达到高峰，乌克兰每日死亡约2.5万—3万人；农村出现人相食记录。乌克兰中央（基辅/哈尔科夫）死亡最集中。

sources.title: The Holodomor（John D Clare）
sources.quote: Spring 1933: Famine deaths peak, reaching 25,000-30,000 people per day in Ukraine; cannibalism becomes documented across the countryside. Millions die in central Ukraine (Kyiv/Kharkiv).

fact: 据Ptoukha人口学研究所与乌克兰历史研究所的联合估计，1932—1934年乌克兰超额死亡约394.25万人，另有出生赤字。

sources.title: Holodomor 1932 to 1933: The Paper Trail of a Famine（projectleaflet）
sources.quote: The most methodologically transparent estimate comes from the joint team at the Ptoukha Institute of Demography and Social Studies in Kyiv, the Institute of History of Ukraine, and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill: 3,942,500 excess deaths in Ukraine for 1932 to 1934, plus a separate deficit in births.

fact: 1932年12月苏联引入内部护照制度（internal passport system），农民被法律束缚在集体农庄上，禁止自由迁徙；农村饥荒下农民无法进城寻找食物。

sources.title: The Holodomor（John D Clare）
sources.quote: An internal passport system legally traps peasants on their collective farms.

fact: 征粮制下农村粮食被强制征收，城市实行票证供应；农民既无口粮也无法进城，黑市在饥荒中成为生存底线，但黑市交易在法律上受惩罚。

sources.title: Holodomor: main facts（乌克兰国家大饥荒博物馆）
sources.quote: It was organised by the Moscow communist regime with the aim of the mass extermination of Ukrainians.

fact: 征粮制下国家以低价强制征购粮食，出口换取外汇用于重工业设备进口；卢布不可自由兑换，城市票证经济使货币交易范围受限，黑市汇率远低于官方牌价。

sources.title: Holodomor: main facts（乌克兰国家大饥荒博物馆）
sources.quote: It was organised by the Moscow communist regime with the aim of the mass extermination of Ukrainians.

fact: 第一个五年计划（1928—1932）结束，第二个五年计划（1933—1937）启动；重工业岗位在城市扩张，大量工人从农村流入，但受内部护照与配给制约束。

sources.title: Holodomor: main facts（乌克兰国家大饥荒博物馆）
sources.quote: the destruction of national self-awareness and the elimination of the foundations of the existence of a separate Ukrainian statehood.

fact: 重工业岗位与内部护照绑定：工人需要城市居留许可与配给票才能生存；农村饥荒下的农民无法自由进入城市工厂，黑市与亲友接济成为非正式生存网络。

sources.title: The Holodomor（John D Clare）
sources.quote: An internal passport system legally traps peasants on their collective farms.

fact: 饥荒导致营养不良与疾病蔓延，农村医疗系统在征粮制下崩溃；黑市医疗与亲友互助成为非正式医疗渠道，但感染与营养不良死亡率极高。

sources.quote: cannibalism becomes documented across the countryside.
